intent: Advance the NovaPulse engine from Phase 3 to Phase 4 by integrating combat mechanics, procedural audio synthesis, and high-performance particle effects.
architecture_impact: Introduces a combat subsystem with object pooling for projectiles and particles to minimize GC pressure, adds a WebAudio-based sound synthesis layer, and refactors the ECS to support active weapon systems and player-controlled combat states.
key_modifications: {'file': 'src/combat/projectile_pool.js', 'change_summary': 'Implemented a pre-allocated object pool to manage projectile lifecycles without garbage collection overhead.'}
{'file': 'src/fx/particle_pool.js', 'change_summary': 'Added an 800-slot particle engine with additive blending for visual effects.'}
{'file': 'src/audio/sound_synth.js', 'change_summary': 'Created a procedural chiptune synthesizer using WebAudio API for real-time sound feedback.'}
{'file': 'src/ecs/systems.js', 'change_summary': 'Extended ECS systems to handle weapon firing, projectile movement, and combat state updates.'}
{'file': 'server.js', 'change_summary': 'Added a native Node.js static file server to replace external dependencies for local development.'}
functionality_gained: The engine now supports active combat (firing projectiles), visual feedback via particle emitters, and procedural audio synthesis, moving from a pure swarm simulation to a functional interactive combat prototype.
